{{Quote|I trust Ka'Pa exactly as far as I can throw him. And I can't.|Kyle Katarn|<ref name="Hutt! Hutt! Hutt!" />}}
'''Ka'Pa''' the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] was a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who ran an [[Ka'Pa's criminal empire|empire]] from multiple locations. In the [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], he enlisted [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to track down escaped dancers from his palace on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], and he later operated with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].

==Biography==
===Early empire===
{{Quote|WANTED ALIVE: B'inka Fibuna<br/ >BRIEF: Escaped from domestic service on Nal Hutta.<br/ >ORIGINATOR: Ka'Pa the Hutt|Ka'Pa's bounty brief for B'inka Fibuna|<ref name="Star Wars: Bounty Hunter">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>}}
[[File:BinkaFibuna-BountyHunter.jpg|thumb|left|150px|B'inka Fibuna, Ka'Pa's escaped dancer]]
During the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="Star Wars: Bounty Hunter" /> Ka'Pa the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] operated a [[Ka'Pa's criminal empire|criminal empire]] from his [[Ka'Pa's palace|palace]] headquarters,<ref name="JK: MotS" /> and he also frequented his estate on the [[planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="CSWE" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="32BBY">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' states that [[B'inka Fibuna]] escapes from the [[Hutt]] shortly after the invasion, so she fled in 32 BBY.</ref> he owned a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] dancing girl named [[B'inka Fibuna]] whom he forced to work at his Nal Hutta estate.<ref name="CSWE" /> She escaped his clutches and fled to the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], so Ka'Pa ordered a live [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on her head, which was eventually claimed by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="Star Wars: Bounty Hunter" />

Ka'Pa was involved in several criminal activities such as [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], [[Spice/Legends|spice]] trading, and arms dealing.<ref name="CSWE" /> Like many [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] of his kind, Ka'Pa employed numerous [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guards and posted them throughout his throne room. He also kept [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]] nearby, a common practice for Hutts.<ref name="JK: MotS" /> After the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] at the hands of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and company, Ka'Pa grew to mistrust [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="JK: MotS" />

===New Republic entanglements===
{{Quote|The New Republic is still in desperate need of supplies, and we aren't always able to locate them through... honest channels. Ka'Pa the Hutt has agreed to sell us these items in exchange for a certain degree of, how shall I say? Amnesty?|Altyr V base's commander, to Mara Jade|<ref name="JK: MotS" />}}
[[File:Confronting_kapa.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ka'Pa confronted by Mara Jade.]]
In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening scrawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' takes place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, we can deduce that ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> the New Republic offered Ka'Pa amnesty in exchange for establishing a supply chain to his empire. With her underworld connections, Jedi apprentice [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] was sent to [[Mission to negotiate supplies from Ka'Pa the Hutt|negotiate]]; however, due to Ka'Pa's prejudice against Jedi, he denied her entrance. The former assassin responded by assaulting his palace and breaking through the stained glass ceiling into his throne room to "negotiate" by force.<ref name="JK: MotS" />

Ka'Pa tasked Jade with a mission to retrieve his [[Global Communications Transponder]] device back from his rival [[Takara]], and then he would be open to working with the Republic. After Mara succeeded and gave the device to Ka'Pa, the Hutt offered the supplies as a gift, in return for Mara's silence: the device was illegal, and Mara, being an "honest" Jedi, must report its existence to [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]].<ref name="JK: MotS" /> Ka'Pa maintained contact with Mara Jade as well as [[Kyle Katarn]], who had been a longtime contact of Ka'Pa's, both serving as the Hutt's liaison with the New Republic.<ref name="Hutt! Hutt! Hutt!" />

===Odd celebrity===
{{Quote|Everyone in the galaxy uses that same image of Jabba, and we're sick of it.|Riccix editors|<ref name="Hutt! Hutt! Hutt!" />}}
Ka'Pa was somewhat of a celebrity, because ''[[Riccix's Revised Basic Holodictionary]]'' featured a [[Hologram/Legends|holo]] of him in the entry on 'Hutts'. The image was taken by the famous [[Holographer/Legends|holographer]] [[Bovit Leebo]], whom Ka'Pa soon killed. After Leebo died, the image fell into the public domain and the editors at [[Riccix]] quickly snatched it up.<ref name="Hutt! Hutt! Hutt!" />

==Personality and Traits==
{{Quote|Mara, you wound me. Perhaps we could just forget all that has happened, and consider the supplies my gift to the New Repuplic's cause.|translated=1|Ka'Pa, to Mara Jade in Huttese|<ref name="JK: MotS" />}}
Ka'Pa the Hutt had [[Color/Legends|orange]] eyes and orange skin.<ref name="JK: MotS" /> Like most Hutts, he spoke [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], but he also spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] though Ka'Pa rarely used it. As a crime lord, he dealt in and enjoyed all kinds of trade, including information, and he kept his personal perspective from interfering with a sale.<ref name="Hutt! Hutt! Hutt!" /> In his negotiations with Mara Jade, Ka'Pa knew when to concede an offer a gift when blackmailed.<ref name="JK: MotS" /> Although he employed many bodyguards, he also knew how to use a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="Hutt! Hutt! Hutt!" /> 

==Equipment==
{{Quote|You're in no position to negotiate.<br />«Neither are you, Jade.»|Mara Jade and Ka'Pa as the Hutt's men fill the throne room|<ref name="JK: MotS" />}}
[[File:KapaPalace.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Ka'Pa's palace throne room]]
As the leader of a criminal organization, Ka'Pa operated numerous palatial retreats.<ref name="Hutt! Hutt! Hutt!" /> While at his estates, the Hutt enjoyed smoking from a pipe while lounging.<ref name="JK: MotS" /> Along with translator [[Droid/Legends|droids]] at his throne, he also kept many [[Weequay/Legends|Weequays]], Gamorreans, [[Gran/Legends|Gran]], and [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] among others at his command.<ref name="JK: MotS" /> Ka'Pa traveled between his palaces in his personal [[Yacht/Legends|star yacht]], but he used a [[Hoversled/Legends|repulsorsled]] or his [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] to move on-planet.<ref name="Hutt! Hutt! Hutt!" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|We wanted Mara to interact with a Hutt, because they are so tied into the "underworld" and that felt like the right place to put her.|Ryan Kaufman|<ref name="BTS Blog">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|4|Kyle and Mara: Making Mysteries of the Sith - Part II: Zombies of the Dark Side}}</ref>}}
Ka'Pa the Hutt first appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' and was voiced by [[Roger Jackson]].<ref name="JK: MotS" /> According to developer [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]], the level design team created Ka'Pa as an original character because the stories of the Hutts already in the [[Star Wars Legends]] continuity "were a bit muddy and hard to pin down." Ka'Pa's Huttese dialogue was specially written by [[Ben Burtt]], the original designer behind the Hutt language.<ref name="BTS Blog" />
